items.q: Can you remove leftover inventory from a closed retail store?
a: Yes. Unwanted inventory, boxes, shelving, displays, furniture, and other store contents can be removed once the items for disposal have been identified.

items.q: Do you clean out retail units in plazas and shopping centres?
a: Yes. We can clear retail spaces in plazas, shopping centres, strip malls, and standalone commercial properties throughout Brampton.

items.q: Can you remove large retail fixtures and displays?
a: Yes. Counters, display cases, racks, shelving, cabinets, and other bulky fixtures can be removed, with larger pieces dismantled when necessary.

items.q: Can you clear a retail space before the lease handover?
